text:
maya (PM): 10-min sync: we need a tiny, unambiguous req/resp telemetry schema for launch. focus: token accounting, trace id, and bounded tool-call info.

sam (API): flat keys only. mobile clients ask for minimal bytes.

linda (Eng): propose tele_ prefix: tele_prompt_tokens, tele_completion_tokens, tele_cost_micros. server can add tele_total_tokens when missing.

rahul (ML): use prompt/completion naming to match models. for embeddings: emb + emb_dim. rerank: rank_score + rank_pos.

noah (DevEx): trace_id: require 16-hex (8 bytes) at top-level. optional parent_id and client_request_id. docs warn about PII in client ids.

sam (API): tool calls: flat cap pattern tele_tool_0_name, tele_tool_0_status, tele_tool_0_out_bytes up to 5 entries. keeps logs indexable.

linda (Eng): gateway will enrich tokens & cost. server values win if mismatch.

maya (PM): launch gates: spec doc, SDK mappings (py/ts/go), docs + examples, gateway canary (48h), telemetry pipeline acceptance.

noah (DevEx): example to ship: {"id":"r_1","trace_id":"a1b2c3d4e5f60123","tele_prompt_tokens":9,"tele_completion_tokens":14,"tele_cost_micros":900}

ops-bot: gateway-canary window scheduled 2026-04-02T02:00Z.

maya (PM): action items: sam draft final compact spec, noah prepare SDK checklist, linda schedule canary, rahul add token-reg tests. reconvene Thu. :rocket:
